subject.title: docs cat drops person smart chips from all output modes (plain, --plain, --json); readable only via --raw

question: Should `gog docs cat` render smart chips in existing text output by default, or add an explicit compatibility-safe mode or field before changing script-visible output?
rationale: The extractor is lossy today, but `docs cat` is a stable scripting surface and VISION.md says behavior changes that could break existing scripts should be discussed first.

options.title: Add explicit chip-aware output
options.body: Preserve exact existing text output while adding a flag or additive structured JSON chip field, then document the migration path.

options.title: Render chips by default
options.body: Fix the silent omission directly by rendering person, date, and richLink elements inline in existing text fields.

options.title: JSON structure first
options.body: Add structured chip data to JSON now and defer the plain-text default decision.

recommendation.title: Add explicit chip-aware output
recommendation.body: Preserve exact existing text output while adding a flag or additive structured JSON chip field, then document the migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history owner for both the current Docs read implementation and smart-chip insertion surface.
